$description: Investigate design tokens, T-010, extended by T-034 (zoom and pan: groups zoom, zoomLayout, zoomInteraction, deepGrid, cursor) and T-045 (M3c: groups curveRole, solo, meterModes, density, headerM3c, stripM3c, popoverM3c, display, toastM3c; ui-spec section 17). Format follows the W3C Design Tokens Community Group draft ($value, $type). All sizes are logical pixels at 100 % scale. Colours are opaque sRGB hex unless an alpha is given separately. Source of truth for source/gui/DesignTokens.h.

note.$value: 1.3.0 (T-065, ui-spec section 18): M3d tokens (toggle-teal, the dB grid ladder, the deprecated tooltip delay, popoverM3d) and M3c tokens (slot, headerSlots, breakpoints, controlBarM3c, spectraPanel, slotWindow, stripSidechain, offset, ab, popoverM3c520, plot-nyquist, sidechain text colours). editorMin is 560 x 400 from M3c (T-070); M3d keeps 920 x 540. Superseded groups are marked in their descriptions. 1.3.0 was revised before approval (2026-10-07, user decision on ui-spec 15 Q23): stripSidechain now describes the full-statistics sidechain table and its fit ladder. 1.2.1 (T-045, narrowed): no value changed.

bg-plot.$description: Spectrum plot region, meter tracks, darkest surface

surface-2.$description: Chip and button fill, segmented-control track

border.$description: Region separators, popover border, card border

border-subtle.$description: Plot data-rect frame, meter track outline

text-on-accent.$description: Text on accent, frozen and clip fills

accent.$description: Selected segment, active toggle, focus ring, drag highlight

accent-tint.$description: Active toggle fill (accent 16 % over bg-app, pre-blended)

state-frozen.$description: Freeze active: button, badge, plot frame

state-frozen-tint.$description: Freeze button fill when active (state-frozen 20 % over bg-app, pre-blended)

state-error.$description: Invalid text entry flash, negative headroom text

toggle-teal.$description: T-065 (ui-spec 18.1.3, 18.3.1): icon, number and 50 % border of the SC toggle (M3d) and the slot visibility toggles (M3c) while on. Same value as meter.safe (#11). 8.8:1 on bg-app

toggle-teal-tint.$description: T-065: fill of an on visibility toggle (toggle-teal 16 % over bg-app, pre-blended). toggle-teal on it 6.6:1

plot-nyquist.$description: T-065 (ui-spec 18.8): fill of the plot region above the Nyquist frequency, in the cached grid image (bg-app value); edged by a 1 px grid-major line

primary-a.$description: Primary curve, and first curve of dual modes (L or M). Line plus vertical gradient fill.

primary-b.$description: Second curve of dual modes (R or S). Line only.

secondary-a.$description: Secondary curve for primary-a. Opaque, pre-darkened.

secondary-b.$description: Secondary curve for primary-b in dual modes.

sidechain.$description: Sidechain reference: flat silhouette fill plus a thin dim edge. Drawn first (behind everything).

track-line.$description: Faint horizontal line across tracks at each labelled tick

rangeDbfs.$description: Bar geometry in dBFS for every scale

zonesK.$description: K-20/K-14/K-12 zone thresholds in K units

peakFallDbPerS.$description: M3b only; from M3c the peak part falls 20 dB per meterRelease (ui-spec 17.10.4)

peakHoldMs.$description: M3b only; from M3c the hold time is meterPeakHold (ui-spec 17.10.4)

holdFallDbPerS.$description: M3b only; from M3c the hold tick falls 20 dB per meterRelease (ui-spec 17.10.4)

sc-opacity.$description: T-065 (ui-spec 18.10.3): opacity of the sidechain metrics relative to the main metrics. Drawn as the pre-blended colours below, never as an alpha layer

sc-text-value.$description: Sidechain values: text-primary at 72 % over surface. 8.2:1 on surface (main values 14.9:1)

sc-text-label.$description: Sidechain labels, heads and units: text-secondary at 72 % over surface. 4.7:1 on surface (main labels 7.9:1)

sc-peak-alpha.$description: Peak part of a sidechain bar: the sidechain colour pre-blended at 55 % over bg-plot, computed once per colour change

family-ui.$description: Downloaded by T-021 into third_party/fonts/ and compiled into InvestigateAssets (not in assets/ui/)

family-mono.$description: Downloaded by T-021 into third_party/fonts/ and compiled into InvestigateAssets (not in assets/ui/)

caps.$description: Chip labels, section titles, table header, channel letters

readout.$description: Meter table values, correlation value, hover rows

popover.$description: Only shadow in the UI; render once into a cached image when the popover opens

clickDeferMs.$description: Delay before a single click opens a menu or text entry, so a double-click can reset instead

tooltipDelayMs.$description: Deprecated by T-065 (ui-spec 18.1.1): the editor shows no tooltips

editorMin.$description: From M3c (T-070, ui-spec 18.9.1). M3d (T-066) keeps editorMinM3d

zoom.$description: T-034, ui-spec 5.9. Every alpha colour is drawn as one fillRectList (no layers). Values reuse the palette except overview-fill.

panel-fill.$description: Zoom panel fill, opaque (same value as color.card)

panel-border.$description: Zoom panel 1 px border, overview strip 1 px frame, Fit button border (color.border)

range-text-zoomed.$description: Range text of an axis that is zoomed (text-primary), 14.6:1 on panel-fill

range-text-full.$description: Range text of an axis at its home range, Fit label (text-secondary), 7.7:1 on panel-fill

fit-hover-fill.$description: Fit button hover and pressed fill (surface-3)

fit-pressed.$description: Fit button pressed border and text (accent), 8.3:1 on surface-3

overview-fill.$description: Overview curve body, one bar per physical column: accent 20 % over bg-plot, pre-blended. Decorative (1.5:1), always paired with overview-line

overview-line.$description: Overview curve top line, 1 physical px rects, 5.2:1 on overview-bg

overview-shade.$description: Dims the strip outside the view window (up to 4 rects)

window-stroke.$description: View window outline, 1 px (accent), 11.5:1 on overview-bg

window-fill-hover.$description: Inside the window while the pointer is over its hit area

window-fill-drag.$description: Inside the window while it is dragged

window-ghost.$description: 1 px outline of the window a press would centre (text-tertiary), 5.0:1 on overview-bg

box-stroke.$description: Box-zoom rubber band outline, 1 px (text-primary), 16.4:1 on bg-plot

box-target.$description: 1 px outline of the widened result when a box axis is below its minimum span (text-tertiary)

zoomLayout.$description: Zoom panel geometry (ui-spec 5.9.6). Panel x = data.right - insetRight - width, y = data.y + insetTop, width = clamp(round(data.w * widthRatio), minW, maxW). Rects are panel-relative.

row3.$description: Bin-spacing hint, only below binHintBins: (8, 42, W - 16, 16)

strip.$description: Overview strip: (6, 46, W - 12, 40), or y 62 with the bin row

windowMinPx.$description: Visual minimum of the view-window rectangle per axis

windowHitMinPx.$description: Minimum hit area of the view-window rectangle per axis

hoverCardExclusion.$description: The hover card avoids the panel bounds inflated by this much

toastClearance.$description: A centred toast ends at least this far left of the panel

notchFactor.$description: Span factor per wheel notch zooming in; out is 1 / 0.8 = 1.25

juceDeltaPerNotch.$description: MouseWheelDetails delta JUCE reports on Windows for one 120-unit notch (60 / 256)

browserPxPerNotch.$description: Mockup only: WheelEvent deltaMode 0; deltaMode 1 uses 3 lines per notch

dragThresholdPx.$description: Euclidean distance from the press point; same as layout.clickSlopPx

boxCancelPx.$description: A box narrower or lower than this at release cancels

horizontalPanPerNotch.$description: Fraction of the visible log-frequency span per horizontal notch

binHintBins.$description: Show the bin spacing when fewer bins than this lie in the visible span

hoverSigFigsZoomed.$description: Hover and clipboard frequency precision while the visible span is below hoverPrecisionOctaves

gridIdleRebuildMs.$description: Rebuild the cached grid image after the view has been still this long

viewEpsilonLn.$description: A frequency edge within this (natural log) of home counts as at home

dbSteps.$description: T-065 (ui-spec 18.1.6): 2 dB removed so the default range uses 3 dB. Step = smallest s with s >= span / dbMaxLines and s x pxPerDb >= dbLineMinPx

dbLabelMinPx.$description: Labels on every line when the step spacing reaches this; otherwise on multiples of 2 x step. Replaces dbStepMinPx

cursor.$description: Custom cursors (ui-spec 5.9.4). Fixed black and white, not recoloured. Render at 24 px x display scale.

curveRole.$description: M3c colour roles (ui-spec 17.4). Defaults are applied on first launch and by Reset; stored opaque in GlobalSettings. The first four equal the M3b curve tokens. SUPERSEDED in part by the slot group (T-065, ui-spec 18.2 and 18.5): primary, underlay, sc1 and sc2 become the four slot colours; secondaryDefaults, derivation.secondary*, the underlay style entries and drawOrder are no longer used. Still valid: ref1 to ref4, refThickness, refDash, warnContrastBelow, sc2Hatch* (now slot 4's hatch).

primary.$description: Used exactly while the primary role equals its default

underlay.$description: Used exactly while the underlay role equals its default

secondaryValueFactor.$description: HSV value x 0.68, hue and saturation kept

secondaryMinContrast.$description: Raise value in 0.01 steps until 3:1 against bg-plot or value = original

warnContrastBelow.$description: Colour editor warning threshold against bg-plot

sc2HatchStridePx.$description: One 1-logical-px bar at every 3rd logical column

refThickness.$description: Column-span thickness: max(1, round(1.5 x scale)) physical px

refDash.$description: On/off lengths along x in logical px

edgeStubPx.$description: Stub at the data-rect edge when an edge is outside the view

meterModes.$description: M3c metering modes (ui-spec 17.10.2), in menu order. index = meterScale choice index. range in display units; tickSteps are candidates, the smallest with at least 20 px spacing wins. bias in dB added to the level part.

menuSeparatorsAfter.$description: Positions in menu order (0-based) after which a separator is drawn

kRangeNote.$value: K ranges are in K units: the bar geometry is -60 ... +6 dBFS as in M3b

loudnessBarColour.$description: meter.safe; one programme bar, no zones

releaseDbPer.$description: Peak part falls 20 dB per meterRelease; hold tick after meterPeakHold likewise

density.$description: M3c Density style (ui-spec 17.10.5). q = floor(7 x sqrt(d) + 0.5); q = 0 is not drawn.

levelNotch.$description: w x h, text-primary, at both inner track edges

headerM3c.$description: SUPERSEDED in full by headerSlots and breakpoints (T-065, ui-spec 18.9.2). Kept for history. M3c header (ui-spec 17.2). Rects are [x, y, w, h]; negative x means W + x.

popoverM3c.$description: M3c popovers (ui-spec 17.11, 17.13, 17.16). SUPERSEDED for sizes and rects by popoverM3c520 (T-065, ui-spec 18.12): every right-anchored popover is 520 wide, the Inputs tab is removed, Take and Take 2nd become Take menu. Durations and character limits below stay valid. Colour-preset dialogs sit at curvesPanel + (120, 312).

popoverM3d.$description: T-065 M3d Settings popover without duplicates (ui-spec 18.1.4). Sections in order; the first non-empty one in column 1, the rest stacked in column 2.

emptyMessage.text: Every setting is on the main window at this size.

breakpoints.$description: T-065 (ui-spec 18.9.1): one set of width breakpoints for the whole editor from M3c. Height has none.

headerIconButtons.$description: Below: Refs, Freeze, Reset curves are 28 x 28 icon buttons

headerCompact.$description: Below: logo mark, compact Spectra group, icon Presets and Copy, Offset in the Spectra panel

compactLayout.$description: Below: 120 px meter strip with bars and correlation only

slot.$description: T-065 spectrum slots (ui-spec 18.2, 18.5). Colours are GlobalSettings defaults; names are ViewState defaults.

heldStrokeWidth.$description: RT max, All-time max, All-time avg; slot colour, opaque

silhouetteFillAlpha.$description: Real-time slot with a sidechain source, Fill off

fillOnAlpha.$description: Any slot with Fill on: flat fill to the data bottom

hatchSlots.$description: Slots whose fills are hatched instead of flat

headerSlots.$description: T-065 header (ui-spec 18.9.2). [x, y, w, h]; negative x means W + x; Pw rules per tier.

controlBarM3c.$description: T-065 control bar (ui-spec 18.9.3). Items of group A shown in order while they fit; group C only if all of A fits and 508 + 20 + 352 <= avail.

stripSidechain.$description: T-065 sidechain meters and fit ladder (ui-spec 18.10), compact strip (18.9.5). Revised 2026-10-07 (user decision on 15 Q23): every sidechain shows the full statistics set in one sidechain table at full content width below the main sections; the reduced block (blockFullH 124, blockShortH 52) is withdrawn.

tableX.$description: strip-relative; the sidechain table always spans the content width

$value: SC loudness and correlation rows give way (two sidechains)

$value.step4: SC loudness and correlation need more height.
$value.step5: Sidechain readouts need a taller window.

compactScCorrLineH.$description: two lines per connected sidechain (correlation, balance)

easeMs.$description: DSP time constant (T-067), mirrored by the mockup

popoverM3c520.$description: T-065 (ui-spec 18.12): every right-anchored popover is 520 wide at (W - 532, 48), so it fits the 560 px minimum.
